claim: SILEX can proceed without using personal content from the municipal register.
evidence: The core of the pilot is based on administrative metadata and interoperability rules.

claim: Legal uncertainty must appear as an explicit restriction rather than be hidden by a technical decision.
Publication of the catalogue and final transfer require evidence of licence, provenance, validation, and access control.
Formal confirmation from Santa Marina will be the determining document for any use of registration data beyond a limited internal test.
Before a municipal dataset is loaded, the authorization record must precisely identify the source system, included fields, purpose, people with access, and destination environment.
It must state whether authorization covers a copy, remote consultation, or synthetic data only.
It must also set a review date and explain what will happen when the pilot ends.
A generic reference to the project does not replace this information.
The person responsible for loading will check that the received file matches the authorization record.
If additional fields appear, loading will stop until their treatment is confirmed.
The manifest will record the result of this check, the file checksum, and any filtering performed before storage.
Pending datasets will remain separate from authorized datasets so that an automated task cannot include them in a publication.

The pre-publication review must answer five questions: whether the dataset has a sufficient licence, whether it contains only necessary fields, whether versions and validity periods are correct, whether unnecessary personal data has been removed, and whether provenance explains every value.
The answers must be documented by both a technical reviewer and a person responsible for licences or privacy.
Where a record combines sources with different conditions, the most restrictive condition will apply to the combined product unless the parts can be separated verifiably.
Licence errors are blocking even where the record has passed technical tests.
The final package will contain an exclusion list with reasons so that absence of a dataset is not interpreted as an ingestion failure.
